title: Infrastructural Occupational Health and Safety
summary: Placeholder summary — replace with real description.
body: Our research and implementation initiative in Infrastructural Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) focused on integrating comprehensive risk management and hazard control across large-scale engineering and construction projects. Covering 61 districts in Bangladesh, the project strengthened institutional capacity within LGED and partner organizations, equipping field engineers, project supervisors, and consultants with essential tools to identify, monitor, and mitigate critical workplace hazards.Our team’s collective work spanned high-voltage energy transmission, road corridor logistics, heavy industrial civil works, coastal and environmental infrastructure, and rural development projects. We developed and deployed field-tested OHS controls-ranging from deep excavation protocols, fall protection, and structural safety inspections to daily toolbox meetings, labor management plans, and environmental-social compliance auditing. By advancing knowledge transfer and field-level capabilities, our initiative established lasting frameworks for climate-resilient, compliant, and safe execution across the infrastructure lifecycle.
